userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The price of the parking or product itself, before fees and taxes: the part paid in money (a validation's share is a paymentType validation line, not base) (Part 13 §13.6a).
A per-transaction fee the customer pays for using a payment channel such as a mobile app or online booking, collected on top of the price (Part 13 §13.6a).
A fee for a service sold with the parking, other than the parking itself and other than a channel fee (Part 13 §13.6a).
A tax collected with the payment, such as a parking or sales tax (Part 13 §13.6a).
